notes.title: Pricing discussion with the community
notes.notes:
We just started a thread in the forum to talk about the pricing model for True Blades™.

If you bought the game or are thinking about it and want to participate in its future, this is a good place to start.

Our goal: an open discussion with our community to put forth a fair price / pricing model for True Blades™ that will enable the game to evolve in the coming year.

Come [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/542410/discussions/0/2592234299533525938]to this forum thread[/url] and talk with us.

notes.notes:

We just started a thread in the forum to get all your feature requests about how to move in True Blades™ in the same place.

You like our third person movement or hate it ? 
You want to add another way to move ?
